# The D24 audio patch plan

92 patches, 246 measurements, 4 lead changes.

## The kit

| lead | what it is | how it is wired | patches |
|---|---|---|---|
| K1 | XLR-F to XLR-M | straight balanced: pin 1-1, 2-2, 3-3 | 36 |
| K5 | 150 ohm XLR-M terminator | 150 ohm across pins 2-3, pin 1 to the shell | 24 |
| K2 | 6.35 mm TRS to XLR-M | tip -> pin 2, ring -> pin 3, sleeve -> pin 1 | 6 |
| K4 | XLR-F to 6.35 mm TRS | pin 2 -> tip, pin 3 -> ring, pin 1 -> sleeve | 24 |
| K3 | XLR-F to 3.5 mm TRS | pin 2 -> tip, pin 3 -> ring, pin 1 -> sleeve | 2 |

One of each. The order above is the order the station walks, so the operator changes lead type 4 times in a whole pass and never goes back to a lead already put down.

### Not run, and why

These are not failures and not omissions. The socket exists; no cell this product declares can put a signal on it.

| socket | catalog row | why |
|---|---|---|
| PHONES L | 97 | reachable since S144 (DAC_09 = C2_PHN_OUT_L, off the monitor pick-off through `Mon PhonesLevel`) but no patch is written for it yet: a phones patch is a stereo TRS with its own null sub-test and a level cell nothing has measured -- S151 note, owed |
| PHONES R | 97 | reachable since S144 (DAC_10 = C2_PHN_OUT_R, off the monitor pick-off through `Mon PhonesLevel`) but no patch is written for it yet: a phones patch is a stereo TRS with its own null sub-test and a level cell nothing has measured -- S151 note, owed |
